item.name: Chain Mail

stand.note: setpiece.mail_stand() reads this. It is the EMPTY stand so it is right with today's code: the Chain Mail item (on item_cell, the same cell) is drawn in front of it while it lies there, and the stand stays empty after GET

stand_full.state_switch: draw stand_full INSTEAD of stand while a Chain Mail item is in room 24's items on item_cell, and skip that item's floor sprite (like the statue necklace); after GET (or if it is dropped elsewhere) draw the empty stand. Dropping it back on item_cell may restore the full stand
